title: Passport trouble and the spelling of his name
summary: Difficulty with his birth certificate and passport; his French name Goudie and Francis/Frank.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: I have a French name, and it's, it's my name, and I wanted it. You know. And they, they changed my first name, because my first name is Francis. Right. They called me Frank, so I took Frank. It's the same family with Francis.
The, uh, the European boys spelled it G-O-O-D-I-E, didn't they?

Well, they, because they picture it in English. Yeah. You see? They said that English is G-O-U-G down below. They, they don't, they don't realize it's a French name. They use G-O-U. Yeah. In French, if you pronounce G-O-O, it wouldn't sound the same as in English. Oh, it does. Yeah. So they don't think about that. They say, I'm an American, it should be spelled that way. But I'm an American born French, that's all I know about.
